0022600228.text: The Detroit Pistons (7-3, first in the Central and third in the East) head on the road to face the Washington Wizards (4-8, 11th in the East), who are on a five-game losing streak and 3-7 over their last ten. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Ugonna Onyenso is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision, while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
